output.response_text:
Dear Enterprise Client 27,

Thank you for bringing the intermittent 500 Internal Server Errors you are experiencing with our API webhook to our attention. We understand how critical reliable webhook functionality is for your operations, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

We have escalated this issue to our senior API/Webhook engineering team (Tier 2) and have also notified your account manager. To expedite our investigation, could you please provide the following information?

- Exact timestamps (including time zone) when the 500 errors occurred and how frequently they were observed.
- Sample request payloads that triggered the failures.
- Details of any recent changes to your webhook configuration, deployment, or authentication tokens.

Our engineering team will:
1. Review the webhook service logs and correlate them with the timestamps you provide.
2. Verify authentication token validity and check for any rate‑limit or throttling events.
3. Identify the root cause (e.g., unhandled exception, rate‑limit breach) and develop the appropriate fix.
4. Perform targeted testing with the supplied payloads to confirm the issue is resolved.
5. Monitor the webhook for 24 hours after the fix and update you on the outcome.

We will keep you informed throughout this process and aim to resolve the issue within the 2‑business‑day SLA window.

Thank you for your cooperation and patience.

Sincerely,
Customer Support Team
